correctness.rationale: The weight-3 reduced Świątkowski chain basis and integral differentials are completely enumerated with chain ranks (165,540,540,160). Boundary-square identities hold, unit-pivot Smith reductions give d1=1^164, d2=(1^371,2), d3=1^160, hence integral ranks (1,4,8,0) and exactly one H1 2-torsion factor. All 72 graph automorphisms commute with the integer differential on every basis generator. Character image traces computed modulo 10007 lift uniquely to characteristic zero because the boundary rank is unchanged and finite-order integral traces have absolute value <=540. Nine class values and nine irreducible inner products are exactly checked. Independent subdivided Abrams cubical model returns mod2 ranks (1,5,9,0), mod3 ranks (1,4,8,0), and all 72 matching equivariant Lefschetz numbers. This proves the stated rational representation classifications, not an equivariant homotopy splitting.

value.rationale: The nonplanar Kuratowski graph K3,3 is a canonical, exceptionally symmetric test graph, not an arbitrarily selected finite slice. The explicit decomposition H2=D^-(Std) ⊕ Ind(sgn ⊠ Std) distinguishes two inequivalent 4-dimensional rational homology representations and proves absence of invariant classes, neither of which follows from the known rank eight alone. It provides a concrete equivariant refinement of the published K3,3 configuration study without claiming a new Betti number, a general family theorem, or an equivariant homotopy classification.
